Internal Communications and Employee Engagement Software
NewZapp is a UK-hosted internal communications and employee engagement platform. It enables organisations to create and send branded email communications, manage employee audiences, run surveys and polls, publish landing pages and QR-code campaigns, and measure engagement through detailed analytics.

Trusted By:
Sovereign Network Group Logo
Exeter College
internal communications provider
housing association internal comms
Internal Communications
Increase employee engagement with internal communications that make a difference
No matter where you are on your employee engagement journey, we have the internal communications solution for you.

Dynamic content
Dynamic content allows you to automatically tailor parts of an email or landing page based on who the recipient is, what they need, or what matters to them at that moment. Instead of sending one static message to everyone, you can adapt text, images, calls to action or entire sections so each person sees content that is relevant to them.
Dynamic Content
Employee Surveys
Engage, measure, and analyse with NewZapp’s comprehensive survey tools, built into the platform at no extra charge. Administer employee engagement surveys to enhance company culture. Target specific audience segments with tailored questionnaires and surveys, driving success with two-way communication.
Employee Surveys
Data Security
With no data security breaches since our inception over 25 years ago, we are extremely proud to continually provide a service our customers can rely on. We maintain the very highest security standards and ensure our supply partners do the same. In additional to the industry standard accreditations, we have ISO 27001.
Data Security

Breath of fresh air
We’ve come from a world of counting it a success if we could just get an email to our staff to now creating attractive emails for specific audiences and seeing exactly how our staff are interacting with them. It's such a breath of fresh air. Finally we can do internal communications properly again.

Lydia Davies
Salisbury NHS Foundation Trust
internal communications email
Detailed analytics
The NewZapp system is providing us with detailed analytics and a greater level of understanding on what staff are reading. This is helping us to create more engaging and valuable content on subjects they want to hear about.

Andrew Manning
Network Rail
